svg.title: Chlorophyll and preceding upstream-flow context
svg.desc: The same 75 selected samples, with original dates joined to the observed upstream gauge. Vertical reference = annual daily-flow 95th percentile, 134.8 ft3/s. The prior-seven-day maximum excludes the sample date. Identical horizontal coordinates across sites reflect a shared upstream context; each lake measurement retains its own site. Plot data include original activity IDs, values, units, agency file hashes and every antecedent USGS source-record index.

svg.text: The same 75 selected samples, with original dates joined to the observed upstream gauge.
Each point is an actual lake sample.
Filled points followed a daily mean at or above
the annual 95th percentile within the preceding week.
The upstream context is shared across sites.
No regression or causal attribution is applied.
Vertical reference = annual daily-flow 95th percentile, 134.8 ft3/s. The prior-seven-day maximum excludes the sample date.
Identical horizontal coordinates across sites reflect a shared upstream context; each lake measurement retains its own site.
Plot data include original activity IDs, values, units, agency file hashes and every antecedent USGS source-record index.
